body: Physics: recommend avian3d 0.7.0 (bevy ^0.19.0, native MoveAndSlide, ECS-native, same author ecosystem as tnua/ahoy/rerecast/vleue). Alternative bevy_rapier3d 0.36.0 (bevy ^0.19.0) kept as fallback; rejected as primary because Tnua-rapier lags (0.17 pins bevy_rapier3d ^0.35) and neither exposes a vehicle controller.

Character controller: recommend bevy-tnua 0.32.0 + bevy-tnua-avian3d 0.12.1 (floating dynamic body, knockback builtin, config as asset). Alternatives: bevy_ahoy 0.2.0 (kinematic, Quake/Source movement, hard-wired to bevy_enhanced_input) and hand-rolled KCC over avian MoveAndSlide (fallback).

AI crates rejected: big-brain last release 0.22 supports bevy ^0.15; bevy_behave 0.5.0 supports bevy ^0.18 only; oxidized_navigation 0.12 supports bevy ^0.15; bevy_third_person_camera 0.4 supports bevy ^0.18; iyes_perf_ui 0.5 supports bevy ^0.16. None usable on bevy 0.19.

Pin bevy = 0.19.1 (not 0.19.0): vleue_navigator 0.16.0 declares bevy ^0.19.1. bevy_egui must be 0.40.x because bevy-inspector-egui 0.37.0 declares bevy_egui ^0.40.0; alternative 0.42 would duplicate egui types.

NPC AI: enum-FSM per role in one component + small utility scorer only for civilian reaction choice. Alternatives rejected: behaviour trees (only bevior_tree 0.11 on bevy 0.19, BT costlier per GAIP ch.4), full utility (hard to tune), GOAP (loses authorial control).

Navigation MVP: sidewalk/road graph emitted by citygen + pathfinding 4.16 A* + separation steering; direct seek within LOS. Alternative bevy_rerecast 0.5 + avian_rerecast 0.6 + bevy_landmass 0.12 kept as fallback (no tiles, full rebuild only); vleue_navigator 0.16 rejected as primary (no avoidance).

City generation v1: perturbed grid + Voronoi districts + recursive OBB lot subdivision + extruded massing, pure fn in its own crate. Alternatives: Parish-Mueller growth and tensor field as v2 (same downstream), WFC only for local detail.

Humanoid content: Kenney Mini Characters (CC0, 32 clips in one GLB, 14 bones, direct zip). Alternative Quaternius UAL Standard (53 bones, single mannequin) as swap; Mixamo rejected (Adobe login, raw redistribution banned, FBX).
Vehicles are NOT in the owner's brief: recommend option B (drivable cars, no traffic) as late slice T14 and traffic as cuttable T15, routed to Open questions Q1 instead of assumed.

Headshot: keep V2 separate head hitbox but as child Sensor collider in a Hitbox layer; V2 rationale 'does not break on knockdown' is false because Tnua requires LockedAxes rotation, so both head-collider and capsule-height-fraction are pose-blind. Alternative: revert to PLAN.md 85%-height rule.
BUSTED screen moved from T12 to T11: T12 deps (T2,T10) do not include arrest, which T11 introduces. Alternative: add T11 to T12 deps.
bevy_brp_mcp 0.22.6 is a [[bin]]-only crate: install via cargo install --locked, not a Cargo dependency as V2 table stated. Alternative: keep as dependency (would not compile as lib).

Disconfirmation: tried to show bevy 0.19.1 has no SettingsPlugin (V2 upgraded PLAN R12 unverified to asserted). It exists: bevy-settings 0.19.1 src/lib.rs:82, re-exported as bevy::settings only with non-default feature bevy_settings; saving is explicit (SaveSettingsDeferred).
